title: Lifecycle threshold-witness rites
scope: Pattern-level threshold-witness architecture for the four lifecycle rite classes — birth, coming of age, marriage and relationships, death — across the region's three cultures; usable for culture, household, and story development without establishing rite scripts, liturgy, faith content, officiants, calendars, observance detail, marriage-form norms, names or naming language, exchange media, per-culture rite logic, afterlife or Soul fact, protagonist facts, occurred ceremonies, or any change to natural System behaviour.
claims: In all three cultures — the original culture, the imperial-remnant culture, and the hybrid settlement — every lifecycle rite is a witnessed crossing: the community formally witnesses a passage and thereby socially ratifies the new state, and each culture times and staffs its rites by its own custom, none fixed here.
All three cultures possess all four rite classes — birth, coming of age, marriage and relationships, death — and each culture is internally varied in keeping them.
Birth rites witness acceptance into a household: the crossing is into the hearth, not into existence.

Coming-of-age rites witness the culturally interpreted signs of ordinary awakening; they reveal, celebrate, authenticate, teach, and support, they never create, suppress, gate, delay, or own natural access, and awakening timing follows natural law identically for everyone regardless of ceremony, culture, or omission of ceremony.
Marriage rites witness a bond of reciprocal obligation between persons and households.

Death rites witness the community's recognition of a death and the reallocation of the dead person's social obligations among the living; they establish nothing about what actually happens to Souls, and afterlife, reincarnation, and ancestor content is contested belief.

Rites are socially binding only: no rite triggers, gates, delays, guarantees, or owns any System event, awakening included, and no rite creates, transfers, or extinguishes assembly standing, property, or tenure — every reallocation, marriage's inherited-duty obligation class included, is social obligation only.
Rite failure or omission carries social consequence only.
Birth customs aimed at the unborn are beliefs and practices with no mechanical effect on the child's progression, and no ordinary person has prenatal System access, practice, or continuity.

Appraisal-adjacent customs, including any marriage-negotiation disclosure, route only through consent, voluntary disclosure, and narrow authenticated proof — custom, never guarantee — and access to authenticated proof is uneven and often unavailable, so such customs are aspirational, elite, or specialist-mediated in distributions left open.

Marriage and relationship forms are an open qualitative field in every culture: household-formation logics and obligation classes — dwelling, labour, care, inherited duties — vary by culture, strand, and household, and no marriage-form norm, numeric, plural, or monogamous, is established.
Whatever rite practice the hybrid settlement keeps, it echoes no office and claims no governance power.
boundaries: Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open awakening, coming-of-age, and guardianship-custom space: the four rite classes exist in all three cultures under the witnessed-crossing architecture; all observance content remains open.
This record is a forward extension filling that space, and apart from the single declared closure stated above, every open boundary of every record this one touches stays open.

Witness, crossing, acceptance, attestation, record, standing, and every other label in this record are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, language, rite script, liturgy, calendar, office, law, institution, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee.

Per-culture rite expression beyond pattern level remains open; the per-culture emphases sketched in the source proposal — whether a culture stresses who witnesses or what is recorded — are illustration only and are not established, and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/original-kin-hall-season-court-culture, canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture, and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend each remain free to give their own culture a different rite logic from its own societal structure and faith orientation.

Coming-of-age ceremony wraps the natural awakening stage exactly as CAL0 WLD1.0D licenses and never modifies it: an unwitnessed child still awakens, no age, band, timing rule, or eligibility by category is fixed (CAL0 WLD1.1D, WLD2.2D), and the staged awakening topology is referenced, not extended.

Death rites establish belief only: nothing about Soul destination, survival, dissolution, return, or ancestor presence is established or implied, the System's own death reporting stays bounded and uncertainty-declared (CAL0 RES0.10D), and whether any funeral practice has real causal effect beyond symbol is deliberately left unclaimed rather than denied.

Birth blessings, maternal observances, and protective customs aimed at the unborn are belief with no mechanical effect; the series contract's adopted WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected as a read-only constraint — ordinary people have no persistent prenatal continuity, System access, or directed prenatal practice — and this record adopts no project default into the setting and names no reincarnate or exceptional individual; this categorical closure is distinct from the deliberate openness left to funeral practice under CAL0 RES0.10D and does not share it.

Appraisal-adjacent marriage customs are voluntary disclosure and narrow authenticated proof only (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.2D): no readout is guaranteed, no appraisal is omniscient, nobody is screened for latent capacity, and access is uneven under the layered System practice WLD-CULTURE-001 establishes.

No rite creates, transfers, or extinguishes assembly standing, property, or tenure; WLD-CULTURE-002's contested margins over dependents, lodgers, and the not-yet-householded, its untouched property and tenure space, and every designed succession ambiguity stay open and unanswered, and no rite practice acquires an office or governance power (CAL0 SOC1.2D).

Marriage and relationship forms stay an open qualitative field: obligation classes only, no numeric norm, no household-size or partner-count rule, and plural versus monogamous variety across the three cultures stays explicitly varied and open.

canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/original-kin-hall-season-court-culture, canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture, and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend own their own cultures' societal structure, faith orientation, and rite logic, and the settlement-founding record alone owns the settlement's founding frame; this record neither restates nor alters any of it, establishes no cultural precedence, suppression, or completed blending at the settlement, and adds nothing to WLD-HISTORY-001's account of the empire's historical regional administration.

canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/generational-language-landscape stays untouched: recorded and attested claims fix no script, literacy level, speech variety, naming language, or record medium — records may be written, tallied, or memorised in whatever forms that record establishes — and all in-world names, vocabularies, phonologies, and script content remain protected unknowns.

canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/dual-sphere-exchange-media stays untouched: marriage obligations and death-rite reallocations name obligation classes only, fixing and excluding no exchange medium, valuation, price, dowry value, market, or monetary custom.

Rites deepen WLD-CULTURE-001's strand-braid as strand-distinct household customs, never merging or ranking strands; every strand class stays an open protagonist origin, no protagonist fact is established, and within the settlement braid rite timing is household and strand custom, so the festival calendar, dates, and all observance content stay open; this record ties no rite occasion to a festival season, and whether any does remains open.

WLD-HISTORY-001 remains the sole authority for the chronology; imperial-remnant rite fragments are believed inheritances of unestablished accuracy, prior custom is imported and uneven memory, and no imperial-era doctrine, phase, date, or event is established.

WLD-LOCATION-004's no-intact-archives ceiling stands: record customs assume no intact archive or registry institution and no record accuracy, and whatever partial, disputed, or fallible imperial documents WLD-CULTURE-004 establishes stand untouched; WLD-LOCATION-005's outlet settlement keeps its self-described primarily imperial-remnant character, internally varied, with minority presence open.

WLD-EVENT-001 continues to own story-start pressures: no wedding, funeral, naming, or ceremony is an occurred event, contested standing from disputed or omitted rites, witness-availability politics, and record disputes are standing pressures only, and no incident, dispute, or outcome is established.

No rite ties to any harvest practice, organism use, foodway, material, or shore institution; WLD-ECOLOGY-004, WLD-ECOLOGY-005, and WLD-ECOLOGY-006 stand untouched, including the spring-pulse mortality-channel-only boundary and the provenance discipline, and no crop, fibre, fabric, or species is established — material classes only.
No quantitative claim of any kind is made: no age, count, proportion, demography, price, measurement, date, or calendar, and WLD-RARITY-001D's deferral of universal proportions stands.

The architecture is author-side cultural truth as a pattern; a character knows another culture's, strand's, or household's rite customs only through an available, fallible source, and no character surveys the whole pattern.

No new System mechanic, readout, or CAL0 change is created; no WLD-SOUL-001A or other project default is adopted; no Soul scalar or prevalence figure is used; the parked sapient pack species remains parked and the returning non-human peoples remain undeveloped; and no protagonist, character, plot, chapter, or story-event claim is made.
story_implications: Later scenes may use witnessed births, comings of age, marriages, and funerals as social ratification and as sources of contested standing, but every particular rite, officiant, occasion, dispute, belief, and outcome requires its own evidence.

Contested standing from disputed or omitted rites, witness-availability politics, and record disputes are standing pressures at story start, never occurred events, and no ceremony of any kind has occurred as background fact.
A coming-of-age scene can carry full social weight while changing nothing about natural awakening, which arrives on its own schedule for the witnessed and the unwitnessed alike.
Funeral scenes may carry a culture's or household's belief about the dead without the narrative confirming or denying any of it.
Rite customs are not automatic character knowledge: a character knows another culture's, strand's, or household's practice only through an available, fallible source.
system_implications: The selected architecture is an ordinary setting extension: every rite is a cultural wrapper over unchanged natural System behaviour, and ceremony reveals, celebrates, authenticates, teaches, and supports awakening without creating, gating, delaying, or owning it (CAL0 WLD1.0D).

No eligibility by category or band follows from any rite (CAL0 WLD1.1D, WLD2.2D), no rite practice gains System-executed institutional power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), and appraisal-adjacent customs remain consent-routed disclosure and narrow authenticated proof with no guaranteed readout and no omniscient appraisal (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.2D).

Death rites make no claim about Souls; the System's own death reporting stays bounded and uncertainty-declared (CAL0 RES0.10D), the cosmology stays open, and no Soul scalar or prevalence figure is used.
No CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or project-default adoption is created, and the WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is honoured as a read-only constraint rather than adopted here.
research_questions: What observance content do the rites carry — scripts, seasons, officiants, costume, music, foodways, and each culture's actual rite repertoires — including whether rite occasions fall inside festival seasons at all?
What rite logic does each culture derive from its own societal structure and faith orientation, the per-culture emphases here being illustration only?
What faith content sits behind the rites — deities, cosmologies, and which passage or ancestor beliefs which households actually hold?
What guardianship customs surround pre-awakening children and pending entitlements (CAL0 WLD1.0D space, unapplied beyond the architecture)?
Which household-formation logics and obligation classes predominate where, and what are the politics of that distribution?
Does any funeral practice have real causal effect beyond symbol (CAL0 RES0.10D licenses it; deliberately unclaimed here)?
What record media, literacy, and naming logic carry attestation, and what exchange customs sit inside rite obligations?
What internal rite variety and minority practice does the outlet settlement hold?
How do rites meet the approaching first succession — a successor's coming of age, marriage, or funeral politics — with resolution reserved for story evidence?

author_approval.evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'A — THRESHOLD-WITNESS' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option A exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
